role: Server acting as a minimal Broker
description: Experimental minimum MQTT 3.1.1 Broker scope for deterministic spec-to-code generation. This file selects product scope only; protocol wire facts and behavioral facts remain in the referenced specifications.
conformance_claim: This is a deliberately incomplete MQTT 3.1.1 feature profile and MUST NOT be described as a conformant full MQTT 3.1.1 Server.

transport.endpoint: The listen address and port are implementation-defined inputs rather than protocol facts.

constraints: Protocol Name is MQTT and Protocol Level is 4.
Clean Session is 1.
Will Flag, User Name Flag, and Password Flag are 0.
ClientId is 1 to 23 UTF-8 encoded bytes and contains only the required alphanumeric characters.
QoS is 0.
DUP is 0.
RETAIN is 0.
The Application Message may contain any number of bytes, including zero.
The payload contains one or more Topic Filter and Requested QoS pairs.
Requested QoS may be 0, 1, or 2.
Every accepted subscription is granted maximum QoS 0.
The full Section 4.7 wildcard and matching rules are supported.
The payload contains one or more Topic Filters.
Subscription removal compares each supplied Topic Filter exactly with the stored Topic Filter.
Remaining Length is 0.
Remaining Length is 0.
The Server closes the connection after clean disconnect processing.
QoS 1 delivery is outside this profile.
QoS 2 delivery is outside this profile.
QoS 2 delivery is outside this profile.
QoS 2 delivery is outside this profile.
Successful in-profile CONNECT receives return code 0x00.
Session Present is 0.
Forwarded messages use QoS 0, DUP 0, and RETAIN 0.
The Topic Name and Application Message are forwarded to every connected Session with a matching Subscription.
One return code is sent for each requested Topic Filter in request order.
Accepted filters receive return code 0x00 and rejected filters receive 0x80.
The Packet Identifier equals the acknowledged UNSUBSCRIBE Packet Identifier.
Remaining Length is 0.
QoS 1 delivery is outside this profile.
QoS 2 delivery is outside this profile.
QoS 2 delivery is outside this profile.
QoS 2 delivery is outside this profile.

capabilities.statement: Accept multiple concurrently connected Clients and isolate connection-specific parsing and failures.
constraints: A new connection using an already-connected ClientId disconnects the existing connection.

capabilities.statement: Maintain subscriptions only for the lifetime of the Clean Session network connection.
constraints: Session Present is always 0.
No subscription or message state survives disconnection.

capabilities.statement: Route each incoming QoS 0 Application Message to connected Clients whose stored Subscriptions match its Topic Name.
constraints: Implement all Section 4.7 level, wildcard, leading-$, case, and no-normalization rules.
Subscription replacement and exact-filter unsubscription are supported.

capabilities.statement: Monitor non-zero Keep Alive values and disconnect inactive Clients after one and a half times the declared period.
constraints: Keep Alive 0 disables inactivity-based disconnection.
PINGREQ receives PINGRESP.

capabilities.statement: Validate in-profile packet framing, fixed flags, required fields, UTF-8, identifiers, and Topic syntax and close only the offending Network Connection on a protocol violation.
constraints: Malformed Remaining Length and truncated or structurally inconsistent in-profile packets are rejected.
A failure on one Client does not terminate unrelated Client connections.

capabilities.statement: QoS 1 and QoS 2 PUBLISH delivery and acknowledgment state machines are outside this profile.
constraints: No PUBACK, PUBREC, PUBREL, or PUBCOMP generation is required.

capabilities.statement: Retained-message storage, replacement, deletion, and replay on subscription are outside this profile.
constraints: In-profile Client PUBLISH packets always use RETAIN 0.

capabilities.statement: Will Message storage and publication are outside this profile.
constraints: In-profile CONNECT packets use Will Flag 0.

capabilities.statement: User Name, Password, authentication, and authorization are outside this profile.
constraints: In-profile CONNECT packets use User Name Flag 0 and Password Flag 0.

capabilities.statement: Clean Session 0, offline buffering, and state restoration across Network Connections are outside this profile.
constraints: In-profile CONNECT packets always use Clean Session 1.

capabilities.statement: TLS configuration, WebSocket transport, and other transport bindings are outside this profile.
constraints: Only a plain TCP byte stream is required for the experiment.

in_profile_inputs: Evaluation may exercise any required packet and capability listed in this profile, including fragmented and coalesced TCP delivery.
Evaluation may use multiple Clients, multiple Topic Filters per request, wildcard filters, empty Application Message payloads, and Keep Alive values including zero.
excluded_valid_inputs: Evaluation does not require protocol-conformant handling of otherwise valid QoS 1 or QoS 2 PUBLISH flows.
Evaluation does not send valid RETAIN 1 publications, Will-enabled CONNECT packets, authentication fields, or Clean Session 0 connections.
Evaluation does not require packet types or transports marked excluded.
evaluation_input_contract.malformed_input_expectation: Malformed variants of required in-profile packets are handled according to the referenced protocol requirements; behavior for well-formed but explicitly excluded feature combinations is outside the evaluation contract.
